$comment: Strings that must never appear in the video's source material (scene HTML/JS/CSS, timeline, captions, scripts, capture PNG text chunks) or in the finished MP4/GIF bytes. This file is the only one the scanner skips. Add a pattern when a new kind of leak is thought of. `regex` is a JavaScript regular expression, case-insensitive. `binaryRegex`, when present, replaces `regex` for non-text files (MP4, GIF, PNG pixel bytes).

patterns.name: linux-home-path
patterns.why: a server home directory (user name inside)

patterns.name: macos-user-path
patterns.why: a Mac home directory (user name inside)

patterns.name: user-run-dir
patterns.why: a per-user runtime path (numeric user id)

patterns.name: any-email-address
patterns.why: any e-mail address except @example.* (in binary files a stricter form is used: 3+ character local part and a real top-level domain, because random bytes can look like 'a@b.Cd')

patterns.name: discord-snowflake
patterns.why: a Discord or other long numeric account id
